items.title: Nahida stars as Bangladesh crush Indonesia in Asia Cup opener
items.summary: Left-arm spinner Nahida Akter starred with the ball as Bangladesh began their Women’s Asia Cup T20 campaign on a winning note, beating Indonesia by 71 runs in their opening Group B match at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium in the UAE Monday.

items.title: Nahida, Marufa help Bangladesh brush aside Indonesia
items.summary: The pair shared five wickets to bowl Indonesia out for 58

items.title: Miraz joins Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL
items.summary: Bangladesh all-rounder Mehidy Hasan Miraz is set to represent Guyana Amazon Warriors in the ongoing Caribbean Premier League (CPL), the cricketer confirmed in a post on his official Facebook page on Monday.

items.title: 'Intentions are very positive': Tamim on Bangladesh-India series
items.summary: Bangladesh and India are "sincere" in their search for a new date for a white-ball series that was first supposed to take place last year, Bangladesh cricket chief Tamim Iqbal said.

items.title: BCB president Tamim Iqbal 'hopeful' of India touring Bangladesh in 2026-27 season
items.summary: Cricinfo understands that the six-match white-ball series is likely to take place early next year

items.title: Cricketers satisfied with BCB’s BPL explanation
items.summary: The much-awaited meeting between the Cricketers Welfare Association of Bangladesh (CWAB) and the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) took place at the board premises yesterday, with cricketer Nasir Hossain saying afterwards that the players had been informed the Bangladesh Premier League (BPL) would not take place this season.

items.title: Tigresses begin Asia Cup quest
items.summary: Bangladesh women’s team will begin their Women’s T20 Asia Cup campaign against Indonesia in a Group B fixture at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium today.

items.title: Starc goes past Bumrah to top Test bowling rankings for the first time
items.summary: Mitchell Starc returned figures of 6 for 12 and 4 for 39 in Australia's innings win over Bangladesh in Mackay
